name: 7921-multistepdecode-8b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1. Both sizes are written out in vllm-config.yaml rather than inherited.
architecture: Dense LlamaForCausalLM: 32 layers, 32 query / 8 KV heads, head_dim 128, hidden 4096, vocab 128256, max_position_embeddings 131072 with llama3 rope scaling, bf16, 8.03B params (16.1 GB of weights).
load_profile: poisson (OPEN loop), rate 10 req/s, warmup the first 10% by request count, bounded at 200 requests with a 300 s safety cap. The bound and the 10% warmup are part of the declaration: this is a short burst, and a larger bound describes a saturation experiment instead.
workload: Synthetic text, single turn, FIXED SHAPE: 1024 prompt tokens per request -- the first 512 one prefix shared by every request (`prefix_buckets` with `prefix_count: 1`, `prefix_tokens: 512`), the remaining 512 drawn independently -- and exactly 512 output tokens (`ignore_eos`), at temperature 0.0. Prefix caching is off, the engine's default here, so the shared head is a length and not a cache.
purpose: An 8B chat assistant generating half-page replies from uniform thousand-token prompts sharing a common preamble, ten requests per second on one GPU.
launch:
# HAZARD: at this commit the engine REFUSES to start with enable-chunked-prefill or with
# speculative decoding alongside num-scheduler-steps > 1. `enable-chunked-prefill` must be
# written out as false: left unset it is None, and any max-model-len above 32768 turns it on
# by itself (arg_utils.py:832), which then hits that refusal at engine construction.
#
# max-model-len is 32768 and NOT the checkpoint's own 131072, for that same refusal. The guard
# is `use_long_context = max_model_len > 32768` (arg_utils.py:831), so 32768 is the largest
# value that leaves chunked prefill off WITHOUT depending on the explicit false below -- and it
# has to be off both ways, because the two launch paths spell booleans differently: an
# in-process launch hands `enable_chunked_prefill=False` straight to AsyncEngineArgs, while a
# server launch renders this file to CLI flags and a false bool emits NO FLAG AT ALL, leaving
# it None and letting the >32K rule switch it back on. At 32768 the two paths agree.
# Inert at this workload either way: a request is 1024 prompt + 512 output = 1536 tokens, so
# the only thing that actually moves is the derived max-num-batched-tokens
# (`max(max_model_len, 2048)`), and 10 req/s of 1024-token prompts never comes near it.

model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct

tensor-parallel-size: 1
pipeline-parallel-size: 1

dtype: bfloat16

num-scheduler-steps: 8
enable-chunked-prefill: false

max-num-seqs: 256
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
max-model-len: 32768

disable-log-requests: true
